items.prompt: The ready heap becomes empty after only 2 of 4 courses are emitted. What follows under the finite graph contract?

options.text: All courses are complete; remaining count does not matter.
options.why: The output still lacks two required courses.

options.text: The input must contain a duplicate edge.
options.why: The task supplies distinct pairs; a cycle can cause this without duplicates.

options.text: A directed cycle remains among unprocessed prerequisites.
options.why: A finite nonempty remainder with every node having a predecessor contains a cycle.

options.text: The smallest remaining node may be emitted despite its prerequisites.
options.why: That would violate the dependency contract.

items.explanation: A finite nonempty remainder with every node having a predecessor contains a cycle.
